checkin.title: A friendly hello
checkin.intro: Use a USB or Bluetooth QR scanner, or type the code printed on the family card.
checkin.hint: Scan, then press <kbd>Enter</kbd>. The cursor stays here between families.
checkin.searchIntro: Search by family name, guardian name or phone number.
checkin.readyBody: Scan a card or use the staff search to begin.
checkin.success: {count, plural, one {# child} other {# children}} checked in. Hand the receipt to the adult.

flow.heading: B · Choose children
flow.already: Already checked in for this session. Ask the team to check the roster.
flow.linked: This child is linked to another guardian. Ask the welcome team.
flow.noRoom: No age-appropriate room — ask a supervisor
flow.confirm: I am the selected adult and I am bringing these children.
flow.staffConfirm: I have confirmed the adult bringing these children.
flow.failed: Check-in failed. Ask the welcome team for help.
flow.present: Present this receipt to the welcome team.
flow.authorized: Only an authorized adult can collect a child.

card.note: Replacing a card disables the previous card. Print the new card before closing.
card.checkInOnly: For check-in only. This is not a pickup receipt.

camera.unavailable: Camera scanning is unavailable in this browser. Use a USB or Bluetooth scanner instead.
camera.denied: Camera permission was not granted. You can still use an external scanner.

rooms.spacesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No spaces left} one {# space left} other {# spaces left}}
rooms.showing: {count, plural, =0 {No children} one {# child} other {# children}} shown
rooms.emptyBody: Try another name or clear the room filter.

pickup.title: Verify before pickup
pickup.intro: Scan the adult’s pickup receipt. Permanent identification cards never authorize collection.
pickup.exceptionToggle: Lost receipt — I have verified this adult another way
pickup.exceptionIntro: Use only when the receipt is lost. Record how the adult was identified; this is kept in the session history.
pickup.chooseChild: Choose the child after verifying the adult
pickup.reasonLabel: How was the adult’s identity verified?
pickup.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. photo ID matched the guardian record (minimum 10 characters)
pickup.reasonShort: {count, plural, one {# more character needed} other {# more characters needed}}
pickup.matchedIntro: {count, plural, one {# child matched} other {# children matched}} this receipt. Untick any child who is staying.
pickup.adultLabel: Collecting adult — authorized for every selected child
pickup.adultPlaceholder: Identify the adult at the desk…
pickup.noAdult: No single adult is authorized for all selected children. Release them separately.
pickup.identity: I have checked this adult’s identity and read the pickup instructions. The children are ready to be handed over.
pickup.success: {count, plural, one {# child} other {# children}} released to {name}. Say a warm goodbye!
pickup.emptyBody: Children matched to a valid pickup receipt appear here. No child is released by scanning alone.

supervisor.title: Supervisor tools
supervisor.intro: Kiosk links, exports and session controls. Workers do not see this tab.

kiosk.title: Welcome kiosk
kiosk.intro: Open the kiosk on a tablet in a browser profile that is not signed into the staff app. Links expire after eight hours or when the session ends, whichever comes first.
kiosk.revoked: All kiosk links for this session have been revoked.
kiosk.linkTitle: Kiosk link — treat it like a temporary key
kiosk.scanHint: Scan this QR code with the tablet to open the kiosk.
kiosk.empty: No kiosk links have been created on this device.

export.title: Attendance export
export.intro: Download the roster as a CSV. Use its unique-child total in the service report; it is not added to the general headcount.

close.title: Close the session
close.intro: Closing locks the roster and revokes every kiosk link.
close.blocked: {count, plural, one {# child is} other {# children are}} still checked in. Every child must be collected before the session can close.
close.done: Session closed. All kiosk links were revoked.

reason.reissueBody: Explain how you verified the guardian before issuing a new receipt. The old receipt stops working immediately.
reason.transferBody: Record why the child is changing classroom.
reason.closeBody: Record a short note for the session history.
reason.label: Reason (minimum 10 characters)

kiosk.welcome: A big welcome for little people.
kiosk.subtitle: We’re so happy you’re here. Scan your family or child card to get started.
kiosk.heroAlt: Children welcomed into a friendly classroom
kiosk.help: First visit or forgotten card? Our welcome team is here to help.
kiosk.aBody: Hold the QR code on your family card up to the scanner.
kiosk.bBody: Tick who is staying today and confirm their classroom.
kiosk.cBody: You will need it to collect your children after the service.
kiosk.closed: Please ask the welcome team to open this kiosk.
kiosk.idle: This screen clears itself after a short pause.
kiosk.stepC: Step C of C · All done!
